bias_explanation.interpretation: The signed Naadi bias becomes more early at longer horizons (from -6.7 s at 1 stops to -251.1 s at 30 stops). With tau at 1e9 s, the live correction does not decay; this persistent correction is a plausible mechanism for the accumulating early error.
